task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use your left arm to pick the smooth white mug, rotate it, set it down, and hang it onto the rack with two rods sticking out.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架用左臂拿起光滑的白色杯子，旋转它，放下它，然后将其挂在架子上，并伸出两个杆。
